method: Estimate lag-one autocorrelation from detrended full 240-sample continuation; group low rho<.5, medium .5<=rho<.8, high rho>=.8. Split-quantile group-specific standardized slope error correction, minimum group n=30, fallback pooled multiplier otherwise. HAC lag 3 and 24 ten-point median bins.

holdout.all_miscoverage_cases: Deterministically generated by sibling executable; full 87-case ledger in local SG044_holdout.json

findings: Overall loss 20694 to 19422 and wrong decisions 55 to 50.
Abrupt correlation switch 57/80 (71.25%), late correlation switch 59/80 (73.75%), colored control 57/80 (71.25%), each worse than pooled.
Autocorrelation alone conflates stable persistence with nonstationary changes; low-correlation group not populated.
limitations: Grouping performed on entire continuation, not online.
No new unseen noise types; only new seeds from familiar synthetic generators.
Conditional group coverage target does not imply conditional scenario coverage.
87 uncovered cases include generator truth for audit only, never policy selection.
Neither groupwise nor pooled split calibration guarantees protection under nonexchangeable regime switching.
